title: New Dream
content: I was at a resort looking hotel, in a room. There was a copperhead snake in the closet when I opened the door. I had my husband grab it and throw it over the balcony. I wanted to lay down and go to sleep and I was saying “what if there’s more in there” And wanting to go back to the door and open it again woke me up. (Which I’m bummed about because I was sleeping well) lol I got to googling hotels to see if there’s one similar to my dream, and it looked like this. Not sure of the name because it goes to a list.
